features.quote: Termination: (a) model sends a message with no tool call twice in a row (treated as "done"), (b) 40 turns reached, (c) 3 consecutive malformed tool calls.
Apply at most 2 nudges per run, then accept termination.
This framing matters for the judge rubric: we are scoring observable output properties of the transcript, not inferring internal states.
